title: koeleria drucei
intro: Koeleria drucei, commonly known as Koeler's hair grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from digestive issues, skin problems, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Koeleria drucei are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
